summary: Expose current-attempt work progress time on enriched client work and mission detail rows

replay.detail: No replay or stored claim changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, index or migration changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rules changes.

compatibility.detail: Additive optional nullable progress_at on client work and mission step rows. Older servers may omit it; lightweight list null means unhydrated. Existing clients tolerate extra fields.

downtime.detail: No extra interruption beyond the ordinary binary deployment.

manual.detail: No manual data changes. Deploy the containing binary before consumers require progress_at; absence remains unknown.

recovery.detail: No database changes; ordinary binary swap-back preserves claims and merely omits the additive field.
